question: In which year did Teejanbai, the well- known artist of Pandavani music win the Padma Vibhushan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2019**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In** **2019**, Teejanbai, the well- known artist of Pandavani music win the Padma Vibhushan.
 
• Teejan Bai is a proponent of Pandavani, a traditional art form, from Chhattisgarh, in which she approves tales from the Mahabharata, with musical background.
 
• The Mahabharata is one of the two major Sanskrit Saga of ancient India the other being the Ramayana.
 
• It tells the struggle among two groups of cousins in the Kurukshetra war and the destiny of the Kaurava and the Pandava princes and their beneficiaries.
 
• It also contains Philosophical and devotional material, such as a discussion of the four "goals of life" or Purusartha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pandavani:

 
 
• It is a folk singing style that involves the narration of tales from the Mahabharata. 
 
• In this story, Bhima, the second eldest Pandav is the hero.
 
• It is sung in states like Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Orissa, and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Jhaduram Dewangan, Teejan Bai, and Ritu Verma are associated with Pandavani
